# Blog page source archive

This folder stores source copies of article HTML files in the repository.

Public website pages live under `/blog/`.

To add another pasted page:

1. Copy `/blog/new-post-template.html` into a new folder under `/blog/`, for example `/blog/steel-connection-notes/index.html`.
2. Paste the article HTML into the copied file.
3. Add a card for the article in `/blog/index.html`.
4. Optionally add a matching card on the homepage blog section.
5. Commit and push the files to GitHub.

The current public article is `/blog/introduction-to-abaqus-fea/`.
